title: Grateful Dead Live at Oakland Auditorium on 1982-12-26
lineage: PCM -> Peak -> Samplitude Professional v10.1 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Clean soundboard capture of a mixed‑energy 1982 New Year’s run show, highlighted by Phil Lesh’s first 6‑string bass appearance.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its spectacularly clean sound and careful post‑show cleanup, delivering an excellent listening experience despite the performance being described as uneven—some moments were mediocre while others sparkled with effervescence. Reviewers also note the historical significance of Phil Lesh possibly debuting his 6‑string bass on this night, and they appreciate the West Coast vibe of the set.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is mixed but generally enjoyable; recording quality is described as excellent. Weighted combination (70 % show, 30 % recording) yields a solid four‑star rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers repeatedly emphasize the spectacularly superior recorded sound and post‑show cleanup; no complaints about dropouts or muffiness.

band_member_comments.Phil: Possibly his first show playing a 6‑string bass, noted as a historic moment.
